svg.font-family: Inter, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Food lot release — BPMN collaboration
svg.desc: A contract laboratory exchanges sample registration, test orders, test reports and receipt confirmations with a food manufacturer. QA reviews batch records in parallel with an expanded laboratory-result validation subprocess. A non-interrupting 48-hour boundary timer flags an overdue report. Unit mapping errors are thrown and caught within the validation exception route, repaired, and retried. QA disposition releases or rejects the lot. Data objects, persistent stores and an annotation make the information dependencies explicit.
svg.text: Laboratory results, batch records and QA disposition · One finished-product lot per instance
